name: Sorcerer

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

summary: A born spellcaster whose innate magic bends spells with Metamagic and burns Sorcery Points for raw power.

recommended.note: Charisma first, then Constitution for Hit Points and Concentration.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.summary: Cast Sorcerer spells with Charisma; four cantrips and two prepared spells to start.
features.text: You know four Sorcerer cantrips (more at levels 4 and 10) and prepare level 1+ Sorcerer spells for which you have slots, as many as the Prepared Spells column shows. Whenever you gain a Sorcerer level you can replace one cantrip and one prepared spell with others from the Sorcerer list. Charisma is your spellcasting ability, and an Arcane Focus can be your focus.

features.name: Innate Sorcery
features.summary: Bonus Action, twice per Long Rest: for 1 minute your Sorcerer spells get +1 save DC and Advantage on attack rolls.
features.text: An event in your past left an indelible mark on you. As a Bonus Action you can unleash that magic for 1 minute: the spell save DC of your Sorcerer spells increases by 1, and you have Advantage on the attack rolls of Sorcerer spells you cast. You can do this twice, regaining both uses on a Long Rest.

features.name: Font of Magic
features.summary: Sorcery Points equal to your Sorcerer level; turn them into spell slots or slots into points.
features.text: You have Sorcery Points equal to your Sorcerer level, as the Sorcery Points column shows, and regain all of them on a Long Rest. As a Bonus Action you can create a spell slot by spending points (2 for a level 1 slot, 3 for level 2, 5 for level 3, 6 for level 4, 7 for level 5; no higher than level 5). You can also expend a spell slot (no action required) to gain points equal to its level. Slots you create vanish when you finish a Long Rest.

features.name: Metamagic
features.summary: Learn two Metamagic options that reshape your spells for Sorcery Points (two more at levels 10 and 17).
features.text: You learn two Metamagic options of your choice and can use one on each spell you cast, unless an option says otherwise; you learn two more at levels 10 and 17. Whenever you gain a Sorcerer level you can replace one option with another.

options.name: Careful Spell (1 point)
options.summary: Chosen creatures automatically succeed on the spell's save and take no damage where a success means half.
options.text: When you cast a spell that forces other creatures to make a saving throw, you can protect some of them: choose a number of them up to your Charisma modifier (minimum one). They automatically succeed on the save, and they take no damage if they would normally take half damage on a success.

options.name: Distant Spell (1 point)
options.summary: Double the range of a spell with a range of 5 feet or more, or give a Touch spell a 30-foot range.
options.text: When you cast a spell with a range of at least 5 feet, you can double its range. When you cast a spell with a range of Touch, you can make its range 30 feet instead.

options.name: Empowered Spell (1 point)
options.summary: Reroll up to your Charisma modifier in damage dice and use the new rolls; works with another option.
options.text: When you roll damage for a spell, you can reroll a number of the damage dice up to your Charisma modifier (minimum one) and must use the new rolls. You can use this even if you've already used a different Metamagic option on the spell.

options.name: Extended Spell (1 point)
options.summary: Double a spell's duration of 1 minute or more (up to 24 hours) and gain Advantage on its Concentration saves.
options.text: When you cast a spell with a duration of 1 minute or longer, you can double its duration to a maximum of 24 hours. If it requires Concentration, you have Advantage on saving throws you make to keep it.

options.name: Heightened Spell (2 points)
options.summary: One target has Disadvantage on its saves against the spell.
options.text: When you cast a spell that forces a creature to make a saving throw, you can give one target of the spell Disadvantage on its saves against it.

options.name: Quickened Spell (2 points)
options.summary: Cast a spell that takes an action as a Bonus Action (not if you've cast a level 1+ spell this turn).
options.text: When you cast a spell that has a casting time of an action, you can change the casting time to a Bonus Action for this casting. You can't do so if you've already cast a level 1+ spell on the current turn, nor can you cast a level 1+ spell on this turn after doing so.

options.name: Seeking Spell (1 point)
options.summary: If the spell's attack roll misses, reroll it; works with another option.
options.text: If you make an attack roll for a spell and miss, you can reroll the d20 and must use the new roll. You can use this even if you've already used a different Metamagic option on the spell.

options.name: Subtle Spell (1 point)
options.summary: Cast without Verbal, Somatic or Material components, except costly or consumed ones.
options.text: When you cast a spell, you can cast it without any Verbal, Somatic or Material components, except Material components that are consumed by the spell or have a cost specified in it.

options.name: Transmuted Spell (1 point)
options.summary: Swap a spell's Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison or Thunder damage for another type from that list.
options.text: When you cast a spell that deals Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison or Thunder damage, you can change that damage type to another of the listed types.

options.name: Twinned Spell (1 point)
options.summary: Raise the effective level of a spell that can target one more creature per higher slot level by 1.
options.text: When you cast a spell, such as Charm Person, that can target an additional creature when cast with a higher-level slot, you can increase the spell's effective level by 1.

features.name: Sorcerer Subclass
features.text: You choose a Sorcerer subclass. From now on you gain each subclass feature when you reach its Sorcerer level.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.summary: Gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat you qualify for.
features.text: Take the Ability Score Improvement feat (+2 to one ability or +1 to two, to a maximum of 20) or any other feat whose prerequisites you meet.

features.name: Sorcerous Restoration
features.summary: Once per Long Rest, when you finish a Short Rest, regain Sorcery Points up to half your Sorcerer level.
features.text: When you finish a Short Rest you can regain expended Sorcery Points, no more than half your Sorcerer level (round down). Once you use this, you need a Long Rest to do so again.

features.name: Subclass Feature
features.summary: Gain a feature from your Sorcerer subclass.

features.name: Sorcery Incarnate
features.summary: With no Innate Sorcery uses left, spend 2 Sorcery Points to activate it; while it's active you can use two Metamagic options on a spell.
features.text: If you have no uses of Innate Sorcery left, you can use it anyway by spending 2 Sorcery Points when you take the Bonus Action to activate it. While your Innate Sorcery is active, you can use up to two of your Metamagic options on each spell you cast.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.summary: Gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat you qualify for.
features.text: Take the Ability Score Improvement feat (+2 to one ability or +1 to two, to a maximum of 20) or any other feat whose prerequisites you meet.

features.name: Metamagic
features.text: You learn two more Metamagic options, as the Metamagic column of the Sorcerer table shows (four in all).

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.summary: Gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat you qualify for.
features.text: Take the Ability Score Improvement feat (+2 to one ability or +1 to two, to a maximum of 20) or any other feat whose prerequisites you meet.

features.name: Subclass Feature
features.summary: Gain a feature from your Sorcerer subclass.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.summary: Gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat you qualify for.
features.text: Take the Ability Score Improvement feat (+2 to one ability or +1 to two, to a maximum of 20) or any other feat whose prerequisites you meet.

features.name: Subclass Feature
features.summary: Gain a feature from your Sorcerer subclass.

features.name: Epic Boon
features.summary: Gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat you qualify for.
features.text: Take an Epic Boon feat or any other feat whose prerequisites you meet. Boon of Spell Recall is recommended.

features.name: Arcane Apotheosis
features.summary: While Innate Sorcery is active, one Metamagic option on each of your turns costs no Sorcery Points.
